correctness.rationale: Unitary DFT of 2j+1 nodes per ring gives block upper triangular evaluation matrix: rows of order q receive no columns with |m|<|q|. The signed-order diagonal blocks are N_{ell,k} sqrt(2j+1)(1-x_j^2)^{k/2} times Legendre derivatives, whose leading coefficients and Vandermonde determinants are explicit. Multiplicity summation proves constant, pole exponents and collision exponents for all integer L>=2. The resulting log determinant is strictly concave with negative-definite Hessian in each height-order chamber; its boundary tends to minus infinity, giving a unique nondegenerate maximum. The standalone checker passed 387 supplementary assertions after public package creation; finite testing is not substituted for these infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Minimum-cardinality spherical harmonics sampling has a natural determinant/information-volume design objective, previously treated by heuristic or greedy conditioning. Here its entire analytic volume and phase invariance are derived for every bandwidth, with an exact interpolation-singularity boundary. The factorial count of unique nondegenerate local maxima completely characterizes the nonconvex geometry of this natural restricted design: every height ordering is a strictly concave optimization with a uniquely certifiable solution. This is a reusable structural theorem, not an arbitrary small numerical table or a claimed condition-number improvement. Global ordering remains open.
